# FQHEDiskShowBasis

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnDisk` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnDisk/FQHEDiskShowBasis`

```text
FQHEDiskShowBasis, version 0.01

Usage: FQHEDiskShowBasis [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 4)
    -z, --lz-value : total lz value (default value = 0)
    --force-maxmomentum : force the maximum single particle momentum to a particular value (negative from the number of particles and the state total angular momentum) (default value = -1)
    --fermion : use fermionic statistic instead of bosonic statistic
    --boson : use bosonic statistics
    --state : name of an optional vector state whose component values can be displayed behind each corresponding n-body state
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis
    --reference-file : use a file as the definition of the reference state
    --hide-component : hide state components (and thus the corresponding n-body state) whose absolute value is lower than a given error (0 if all components have to be shown (default value = 0)

output options:
    --save-disk : save output on disk
    --output-file : use this file name instead of statistics_disk_suN_n_nbrparticles_q_nbrfluxquanta_z_totallz.basis

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
